- User identity handling is now fully automated and internal; users are no longer asked to provide any ID or open-id—identity parameters are never shown or prompted.
- Documentation and all workflow content updated to align with new privacy/security flow: only system handles user association to reports and analyses.
- Changelog, usage notes, and examples revised to remove any mention of user-supplied authentication or identity details.
- Cloud/report fetching workflow and report output requirements remain unchanged; table formatting for report listing is preserved.
- Numerous documentation and structure improvements for enhanced clarity and easier onboarding.

- Initial release with AI-driven fruit ripeness grading for tomatoes and strawberries using color, gloss, size, and area ratio analysis from images or videos.
- Provides ripeness levels (Mature-Green, Turning, Ripe, Over-Ripe) based on preset standards, with overall harvest guidance.
- Strict open-id verification and retrieval process enforced for user data and history queries.
- Supports both local files and image/video URLs for analysis; automatic cloud-based report querying with formatted table output.
- Bilingual documentation (English/Chinese) and clear scenario examples for use in grow-boxes, greenhouses, and more.
